auth.testimonial_3_name: Prof. Molly Lahad - Medical Psychologist Instructor, Trauma Specialist, CBT, Arts Therapy. President of the Resource Center.
auth.testimonial_3_text:
Why Digi Card Therapy Website?
Many ask ‘what more cards’ on the one hand and on the other hand how to deal with the era of distancing and isolation.
So here on this site you will find a fascinating variety, convenient to work and very friendly. Beyond the variety of cards (pictures, words, sentences) the site is built in an easy way to learn and experience and in an age where we are all ZOOMis, we have a variety of options to enrich the therapeutic session with games that include tools from CBT, ACT coaching andSEE FAR CBT.
We have reluctantly moved from the treatment room in the room to the virtual space and the DIGI CARD THERAPY website offers flexibility and options to continue to be creative, focused and goal-oriented.In my personal opinion, even at the end of the current Corona era, we will need for a variety of patients to use the remote treatment system and on this site, you will find one of the most interesting and refreshing and playful answers.
auth.about_description: Digi Card Therapy is an innovative website providing digital tools and content for therapists and coaches from all approaches. The site was built especially for the community of therapists for the challenging period when many of the treatments take place outside the clinic space, and are conducted remotely. In addition, the site is also suitable for anyone interested in self-improvement.
auth.team_member_1_short_description: Adam is trained in various therapeutic approaches, including highly innovative approaches such as ACT and wilderness adventure nature therapy. After years of a satisfying career, and out of a desire to devote all his time to working with people, Adam made a switch to the field, uniting his love to working with people and nature.
auth.team_member_1_full_description:
Adam Leighton, one of the founders of the site, is himself a qualified therapist who is trained in various therapeutic approaches, including highly innovative approaches such as ACT and wilderness adventure nature therapy. After years of a satisfying career, and out of a desire to devote all his time to working with people, Adam made a switch to the field, uniting his love to working with people and nature. Adam runs a thriving clinic and invests his life to working with patients and creating tools for dealing with challenges and creating meaning. Adam is the co-founder and lecturer in the "Course for the training of CBT-based group facilitators combined with experiential work in nature."


  • • Chairman of a charity for Primary Psychological Treatment in England - Heads Up.
  • • Certified wilderness adventure therapy facilitator.
  • • Member of the Israeli Association for Low Intensity Cognitive Behavioral Therapy.
  • • Co-Founder of the Center for Remote Relations with Dr. Arnon Rolnik.
auth.team_member_2_short_description:
Providing cutting-edge consultancy services: Customer Experience, User Experience and Digital Transformation.
Elad's professional approach is: Observe your customers in action before, during and after you provide them with a technological solution. Do not ask them to describe their problems but build narratives of what they currently do.
Elad holds an MSc. In Psychoanalytic Developmental Psychology and a BA. in Psychology & Computer Science.

For a single deck:

Monthly or Yearly subscription - automatically renews - you may stop the subscription at any time simple click "unsubscribe" by the relevant deck .

Yearly subscription to all decks:

You will be able to use all the decks available on the site - in all of the languages. This also includes new decks we develop during your subscription period.

You may stop the automatic renew at any time (cluck "unsubscribe") and continue to use the system until the end of your subscription period.




All payment are handled by Paypal - you don't have to have a Paypal account- you can use all major credit cards. Once you reach the final stage of the checkout process, you will be taken directly to PayPal’s secure site. Your credit card details are never accessible to us.
